column1: # Layer 2 — causal readings, one axis per row, at reading time. Schema for INSTRUMENT.md.
# input_floor_lo/hi, output_resolution, float_tol are copied by instrument_id from instrument.tsv (fixed before the reading).
# Two scales: signal_magnitude is input; effect/lower/upper/claim_threshold are output.
# Sign: effect/lower/upper are signed along predicted_direction (positive = as predicted); claim_threshold > 0.
# reading is assigned by one deterministic precedence, first match wins:
#   1 unresolved       instrument_valid=0 (for this instrument_id), OR N < N_min
#   2 below_resolution  signal_magnitude <= input_floor_lo, OR claim_threshold < output_resolution   (decided before data)
#   3 detected         lower >= claim_threshold, instrument valid + sensitive
#   4 contradicted     upper < claim_threshold, sensitive instrument, valid control
#   5 unresolved       lower < claim_threshold <= upper (interval straddles; underpowered for this claim)
